description: This file contains makefile definitions and shell script snippets for building root filesystem images, managing package managers (opkg, apk), and handling library building processes in an embedded Linux build system.

methods.name: mklibs
methods.description: Builds and strips libraries and programs for embedded system deployment, managing temporary directories, file identification, and copying operations.

methods.name: opkg
methods.description: Sets parameters for the opkg package manager for installing packages into a specified root directory.

methods.name: apk
methods.description: Sets parameters for the apk package manager suitable for Alpine-based systems.

methods.name: clean_ipkg
methods.description: Removes specific files and resets package records in the opkg status, cleaning up package management metadata.

methods.name: prepare_rootfs
methods.description: Prepares the root filesystem directory, copies files, runs package post-install scripts, enables/disables init scripts, and cleans build artifacts to prepare for system image creation.
